scope: Reviewed inventory of public terrane-core pure format APIs exercised by the exact test catalog, with known implemented-but-uncovered and deferred formats listed separately. These tests perform no I/O, workflow, signing, issuance, verification or private-authority construction.

shared_properties.cbor: Model roundtrip and identical canonical bytes; every truncated prefix; every nested widened nonminimal header, including boolean/null simple values; indefinite string/container rejection; duplicate/reordered keys for every adjacent pair in each nested map; u64::MAX nested length/count claims; sampled bit flips and 32 deterministic byte-range replacements. Accepted mutations must reencode exactly because they may represent another valid model.
shared_properties.binary: Model roundtrip, every truncated prefix and canonical reencoding after bit/range mutations; explicit count/extent/reserved/tag failures.
shared_properties.prefix: Header and chunk envelope APIs deliberately accept prefix/body fragments. Accepted truncations/mutations retain the exact validated header and opaque suffix/body rather than incorrectly requiring all mutations to fail.
shared_properties.limits: Tiny hostile claimed-length headers exercise typed decoder rejection without constructing the claimed allocation. Allocator calls are not instrumented. Maximum resource values are tested where listed, not asserted universally. New graft and embedded-token cases independently frame actual present bodies at65535/65536/65537 Entry bytes and16/17 token blocks with256/257 grants. Borrowed-before-retained-copy source order is separate evidence, not inferred from token refusal or allocation instrumentation.

by_design_embedded_formats: StoreProfile, RefPolicy, SnapshotEnvelope, profile/provenance/receipt fields, checkpoint row and fence nested types have actual encoding/decoding through their public owning records; an additional standalone decoder is not their contract.

Commit, SnapshotEnvelope and AttrRecord signature-preimage encoders are directly exercised; non-stored preimages intentionally omit signatures and have no separate wire decoder. Public owning codecs cover stored records.
Foreign ELF/shebang inputs are parser formats; the public APIs have no canonical foreign-file encoder. Independent parsed field models and bounds checks are distinct from Terrane attribute encodings.
Header and chunk envelope parsers intentionally accept prefixes/opaque bodies. Whole-pack/index decoders enforce complete container extents; the mutation oracle preserves that API distinction.
